roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance within our facility. We are looking to fill this position quickly, with an anticipated start date around June 30th.

In this dual-focused position, you will play a crucial role in both the professional growth of our team and the safety of our residents. You will be responsible for developing and implementing staff training programs, as well as managing our comprehensive infection control initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact in a supportive environment, offering a competitive hourly rate.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Experience with infection prevention and control programs
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.
